Rank 15 - Property

Apartment Maintenance Fee Collection

Building managers collect monthly maintenance, guard salary, utility share, generator cost, and repair fund manually.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 600Recommended monthly charge

BDT 600/month can work because the building pays as a group, not one individual.

7.5Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 600Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 8,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target small apartment buildings, flat-owner associations, market committees, and housing societies.

Residents delay payment, treasurer records are unclear, and monthly expenses are not transparent.

Every flat sees due, receipt, expense, and monthly balance.

Validation signals

  • Urban apartments have recurring monthly collection.
  • Transparency is a strong trust issue.
  • Group payment makes SaaS easier.
  • Notices can reduce phone calls.

MVP modules

  • Flat list
  • Monthly maintenance bill
  • Payment receipt
  • Expense log
  • Due list
  • Resident notice
  • Monthly balance report

Do not build first

  • Do not build property marketplace.
  • Do not handle money custody first.
  • Do not add legal dispute tools.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 5 buildings.
  • Set up flat list.
  • Use monthly bill and due list.
  • Add resident portal later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Committee politics.
  • Cash payment handling.
  • Custom expense categories.
Mitigations
  • Treasurer-only controls.
  • Receipt without custody.
  • Simple expense templates.
